race.comment: Competitive little sprint. TRES MAGNIFIQUE (8) resumes with a nice profile. She won three in a row last time in, all over this trip before finding 1100m in a 3yo Hcp a bridge too far. The market has always held a good opinion of her and this sets up very well for her with no weight. SALUTED (7) was game in defeat here last time out behind FINAL MOMENT who had a very soft run. SALUTED meets that horse 3kg better and can turn the tables. BEAST MODE (1) is a tricky one. His best short course form is very good but these benchmark races he has to carry a lot of weight and what he really wants is a good 3 at Moonee Valley. Still, he should give a sight. BEHAVIOUR (4) is flying and drops 7kg from a game run last time in a good BM74. Only little niggle is back to 1000m from barrier one which looks sticky. FINAL MOMENT (9) won well last time and has claims again.
